chunk.text: HydraKV is a geo-replicated distributed key-value store utilizing a quorum-lease consensus protocol optimized for read-heavy workloads. Under uniform 95% read traffic across 5 planetary regions, HydraKV achieved a median read latency of 1.4 ms and a 99th percentile (p99) read latency of 4.8 ms by servicing reads locally via monotonic read lease grants. Write operations require strict majority quorum consensus with Raft, yielding a median write latency of 74.2 ms across cross-Atlantic links. When partition tolerance is challenged, HydraKV guarantees linearizable reads and sequential consistency for concurrent multi-key transactions.
